title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 2: Jacky Bryant
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．２ 「ジャッキー・ブライアント」
overview:
Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series is a series of eleven Sega Saturn discs released in Japan between October 1995 and March 1996, each containing images of one Virtua Fighter character.

This disc features Jacky Bryant. Jacky, older brother of Sarah is a 22-year-old male from the United States. He is a Indy car racer by trade and of blood type A.

Originally Jacky's name was spelt with an "ie" (Jackie). This was changed for the final version.
